name: pw-cards
label: Cards section (Framework, Authority, Organizations)
description: Section with label, rule, headline, intro and a row of hairline-topped cards, an italic closing line and an optional button. Three card styles: terms with icons, plain columns, and compact.

options.label: Terms with icons and a large definition
Plain columns with a small label

cards.body: Every conversation shapes one. Every meeting, every dinner and every decision shapes the trust and safety of the people around you. You hold more power than you may realize.
cards.definition: Power is the capacity to shape outcomes.
cards.label: POWER

cards.body: It can look like competence, decisiveness and strength. In a crisis it has its place. As a default it produces distance, distrust and isolation, slowly, beneath a life that still looks highly functional.
cards.definition: Power over is the use of influence to control.
cards.label: POWER OVER

cards.body: It holds authority and relationship at the same time. You lead, decide and act while staying connected to the people your choices affect. It is the more disciplined orientation, and it asks more of you than power over ever did.
cards.definition: Power with is the use of influence to stay in relationship.
cards.label: POWER WITH

defaults.closing: The trust you build carries forward in your absence. That is lasting influence.
defaults.headline: A language for power.
defaults.intro: Three terms carry the whole book. They are simple to define. Once you hold them, you see every relationship, every team and every room differently.
